airqualityreadings.aqrecordregistry.desc: BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, uniquely identifying each air-quality reading record

airqualityreadings.envreadref.desc: BIGINT FOREIGN KEY referencing EnvironmentalReadingsCore(EnvReadRegistry). Links this record to its main environmental reading

airqualityreadings.co2ppm.desc: SMALLINT measuring CO2 concentration in parts per million (ppm). Typical range: 300–2000

airqualityreadings.tvocppb.desc: INT capturing total volatile organic compounds in parts per billion (ppb)

airqualityreadings.ozoneppb.desc: INT indicating ozone concentration in ppb

airqualityreadings.no2ppb.desc: BIGINT for nitrogen dioxide concentration in ppb

airqualityreadings.pm10conc.desc: NUMERIC(5,2) measuring PM10 concentration, possibly µg/m³ as well

airqualityreadings.hchoconc.desc: NUMERIC(7,4) for formaldehyde (HCHO) concentration (e.g., mg/m³ or another scale)

airqualityreadings.airexrate.desc: NUMERIC(4,1) indicating air exchange rate (e.g., air changes per hour)

airqualityreadings.airvelms.desc: NUMERIC(5,2) capturing air velocity in meters per second (m/s)

artifactratings.ratingrecordregistry.desc: BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, unique ID for each rating record

artifactratings.artref.desc: CHAR(10) FOREIGN KEY referencing ArtifactsCore(ArtRegistry). Links the record to a specific artifact

artifactratings.histsignrating.desc: SMALLINT rating for historical significance (scale is flexible)

artifactratings.researchvalrating.desc: INT rating for research value (range is flexible)

artifactratings.exhibitvalrating.desc: INT rating evaluating the artifact’s exhibition value (scale is flexible)

artifactratings.cultscore.desc: SMALLINT measuring the artifact’s cultural importance (common range or flexible scale)

artifactratings.publicaccessrating.desc: SMALLINT rating the artifact’s public accessibility or appeal (scale is flexible)

artifactratings.eduvaluerating.desc: BIGINT rating for how much educational value the artifact provides (scale is flexible)

artifactratings.conservediff.desc: VARCHAR(100) describing difficulty in conserving the artifact (possible values: 'Medium', 'High', 'Low')

artifactratings.matstability.desc: VARCHAR(30) for material stability classification (possible values: 'Unstable', 'Stable', 'Moderate')

artifactratings.deteriorrate.desc: TEXT field detailing the specific deterioration rate or pattern (e.g., 'Moderate', 'Rapid', 'Slow')

artifactscore.artregistry.desc: CHAR(10) PRIMARY KEY uniquely identifying each artifact record (e.g., 'ART000012')

artifactscore.artname.desc: VARCHAR(100) providing the artifact’s name or label (free text, no strict list)

artifactscore.artdynasty.desc: VARCHAR(50) indicating the historical period/era/dynasty (e.g., 'Ming', 'Song', 'Qing', 'Han', 'Tang', 'Yuan'). No strict enumeration

artifactscore.artageyears.desc: INT denoting the artifact’s approximate age in years (any integer value)

artifactscore.mattype.desc: CHAR(30) showing the artifact’s primary material (e.g., 'Stone', 'Textile', 'Bronze', 'Jade', 'Wood', 'Ceramic', 'Paper'). Could be enumerated by your policy bu

artifactscore.conservestatus.desc: VARCHAR(150) describing the artifact’s current conservation condition. Possible values might include 'Excellent', 'Good', 'Fair', 'Poor', 'Critical'

artifactsecurityaccess.secrecordregistry.desc: A BIGSERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each artifact security/access record

artifactsecurityaccess.artref.desc: A CHAR(10) NOT NULL foreign key referencing ArtifactsCore(ArtRegistry). Links this security record to a specific artifact

artifactsecurityaccess.ratingref.desc: A BIGINT foreign key referencing ArtifactRatings(RatingRecordRegistry). Associates this security record with a particular artifact rating, if relevant

artifactsecurityaccess.loanstatus.desc: A CHAR(15) indicating the artifact’s loan status (possible values: 'On Loan', 'Available', 'Not Available')

artifactsecurityaccess.insvalueusd.desc: A NUMERIC(15,2) specifying the artifact’s insured value in USD

artifactsecurityaccess.seclevel.desc: A VARCHAR(50) describing the security level (possible values: 'Level 3', 'Level 2', 'Level 1')

artifactsecurityaccess.accessrestriction.desc: A TEXT field detailing constraints on handling/viewing (possible values: 'Public', 'Restricted', 'Limited')

artifactsecurityaccess.docustatus.desc: A VARCHAR(60) indicating the completeness of documentation (possible values: 'Updating', 'Partial', 'Complete')

artifactsecurityaccess.photodocu.desc: A VARCHAR(100) noting photographic documentation status (possible values: 'Outdated', 'Required', 'Recent')

artifactsecurityaccess.condreportstatus.desc: A VARCHAR(80) describing the artifact’s condition report status (possible values: 'Current', 'Due', 'Overdue')

artifactsecurityaccess.conserverecstatus.desc: A CHAR(20) summarizing conservation record status (possible values: 'Review Required', 'Pending', 'Updated')

artifactsecurityaccess.researchaccesssta.desc: A VARCHAR(40) indicating if the artifact is open to researchers (possible values: 'Limited', 'Available', 'Restricted')

artifactsecurityaccess.digitalrecstatus.desc: A TEXT field specifying any digital records or scans (possible values: 'In Progress', 'Partial', 'Complete')

conditionassessments.conditionassessregi.desc: BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, unique ID for each condition assessment record

conditionassessments.artrefexamined.desc: TEXT NOT NULL FOREIGN KEY referencing ArtifactsCore(ArtRegistry). Links to the artifact under assessment. (In practice, should match CHAR(10) type if needed.)

conditionassessments.showcaserefexamined.desc: TEXT FOREIGN KEY referencing Showcases(ShowcaseReg). Ties the record to the showcase if it was part of the assessment

conditionassessments.lightreadrefobserve.desc: BIGINT FOREIGN KEY referencing LightAndRadiationReadings(LightRadRegistry). Associates the assessment with relevant light data

conditionassessments.condassessscore.desc: INT rating or score representing the artifact/showcase condition (scale is flexible)

conditionassessments.conserveassessdate.desc: DATE when the conservation assessment took place

conditionassessments.nextassessdue.desc: DATE by which the next condition assessment should occur

conservationandmaintenance.conservemaint.desc: A BIGSERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each record of conservation and maintenance

conservationandmaintenance.artrefmaintai.desc: A CHAR(10) NOT NULL foreign key referencing ArtifactsCore(ArtRegistry). Ties this record to the maintained artifact

conservationandmaintenance.hallrefmainta.desc: A CHAR(8) foreign key referencing ExhibitionHalls(HallRegistry), if the conservation applies to a specific hall area

conservationandmaintenance.surfreadrefob.desc: A BIGINT foreign key referencing SurfaceAndPhysicalReadings(SurfPhysRegistry). Links to surface/physical readings used in this maintenance record

conservationandmaintenance.conservetreat.desc: A VARCHAR(50) describing the status of conservation treatment (possible values: 'In Progress', 'Not Required', 'Scheduled')

conservationandmaintenance.treatpriority.desc: A CHAR(10) indicating the priority of the treatment (possible values: 'High', 'Medium', 'Low', 'Urgent')

conservationandmaintenance.lastcleaningd.desc: A DATE specifying the last cleaning date of the artifact/hall/showcase

conservationandmaintenance.nextcleaningd.desc: A DATE indicating when the next cleaning is scheduled or recommended

conservationandmaintenance.cleaninterval.desc: A SMALLINT capturing the recommended cleaning interval in days

conservationandmaintenance.maintlog.desc: A TEXT field describing any notes, log details, or issues encountered during maintenance activities (possible values: 'Updated', 'Pending', 'Review')

conservationandmaintenance.incidentrepor.desc: A VARCHAR(50) summarizing the status of any incident reports (possible values: 'Closed', 'Open')

conservationandmaintenance.emergencydril.desc: A CHAR(15) indicating whether emergency drills are 'Current', 'Overdue', 'Due', etc

conservationandmaintenance.stafftrainsta.desc: A VARCHAR(20) describing staff training status (possible values: 'Current', 'Overdue', 'Due')

conservationandmaintenance.budgetallocst.desc: A VARCHAR(50) describing budget allocation status (possible values: 'Review Required', 'Insufficient', 'Adequate')

conservationandmaintenance.maintbudgetst.desc: A CHAR(15) indicating if the current maintenance budget is 'Limited', 'Depleted', 'Available', etc

conservationandmaintenance.conservefreq.desc: A VARCHAR(30) describing the frequency of conservation efforts (possible values: 'Rare', 'Occasional', 'Frequent')

conservationandmaintenance.intervhistory.desc: A TEXT field detailing the intervention or treatment history (possible values: 'Extensive', 'Minimal', 'Moderate')

conservationandmaintenance.prevtreatment.desc: A SMALLINT counting how many significant treatments have been done previously on this artifact/hall

conservationandmaintenance.treateffectiv.desc: A VARCHAR(100) summarizing how effective previous treatments were (possible values: 'Low', 'Medium', 'High')

conservationandmaintenance.reversibility.desc: A TEXT field describing if and how treatments can be reversed (possible values: 'Medium', 'High', 'Low')

environmentalreadingscore.envreadregistr.desc: BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, uniquely identifying each environmental reading record

environmentalreadingscore.monitorcode.desc: CHAR(10) identifier for the monitoring device or sensor (e.g., 'MON000001')

environmentalreadingscore.readtimestamp.desc: TIMESTAMP NOT NULL indicating the date and time the reading was recorded

environmentalreadingscore.showcaseref.desc: CHAR(12) FOREIGN KEY referencing Showcases(ShowcaseReg), linking the reading to a specific showcase being monitored

environmentalreadingscore.tempc.desc: SMALLINT representing the measured temperature in Celsius

environmentalreadingscore.tempvar24h.desc: REAL showing the 24-hour variation in temperature (in °C)

environmentalreadingscore.relhumidity.desc: INT capturing the relative humidity percentage (0–100)

environmentalreadingscore.humvar24h.desc: SMALLINT indicating the 24-hour variation in humidity (percentage points)

environmentalreadingscore.airpresshpa.desc: REAL specifying the measured air pressure in hectopascals (hPa)

exhibitionhalls.cctvcoverage.desc: VARCHAR(100) describing the CCTV coverage (possible values: 'Partial', 'Full', 'Limited')

exhibitionhalls.motiondetectstatus.desc: VARCHAR(50) summarizing motion detection status (possible values: 'Active', 'Maintenance', 'Partial')

exhibitionhalls.alarmsysstatus.desc: CHAR(15) for alarm system status (possible values: 'Armed', 'Maintenance', 'Partial')

exhibitionhalls.accessctrlstatus.desc: VARCHAR(80) describing the level of access control (possible values: 'Maintenance', 'Active', 'Partial')

exhibitionhalls.visitorcountdaily.desc: INT representing the typical or observed daily visitor count (unbounded integer)

exhibitionhalls.visitorflowrate.desc: SMALLINT indicating how many visitors pass through (possible values: 'Low', 'Medium', 'High')

exhibitionhalls.visitordwellmin.desc: SMALLINT specifying the average dwell time (in minutes) per visitor

exhibitionhalls.visitorbehaviornotes.desc: TEXT field for any additional notes on visitor behaviors, traffic patterns, or compliance issues

lightandradiationreadings.lightradregist.desc: BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, uniquely identifying each light/radiation reading

lightandradiationreadings.envreadref.desc: BIGINT FOREIGN KEY referencing EnvironmentalReadingsCore(EnvReadRegistry). Associates light data with an existing environment reading

lightandradiationreadings.lightlux.desc: INT measuring visible light intensity in lux

lightandradiationreadings.uvuwcm2.desc: NUMERIC(6,2) capturing UV radiation in microwatts per cm² (µW/cm²)

lightandradiationreadings.irwm2.desc: NUMERIC(6,2) measuring infrared radiation in W/m²

lightandradiationreadings.visibleexplxh.desc: INT indicating total visible light exposure over time in lux-hours (Lx·h)

riskassessments.riskassessregistry.desc: A BIGSERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each risk assessment record

riskassessments.artrefconcerned.desc: A CHAR(10) NOT NULL foreign key referencing ArtifactsCore(ArtRegistry), linking this record to a specific artifact

riskassessments.hallrefconcerned.desc: A CHAR(8) foreign key referencing ExhibitionHalls(HallRegistry), indicating which hall is involved in this risk assessment (if any)

riskassessments.riskassesslevel.desc: A VARCHAR(50) describing the level of risk (possible values: 'Medium', 'High', 'Low')

riskassessments.emergresponseplan.desc: A TEXT field outlining the emergency response procedures if the risk materializes (possible values: 'Review Required', 'Under Revision', 'Updated')

riskassessments.evacpriority.desc: A CHAR(15) indicating the priority for evacuation (possible values: 'Priority 3', 'Priority 1', 'Priority 2')

riskassessments.handlerestrictions.desc: A VARCHAR(100) describing any handling restrictions (possible values: 'Minimal', 'Strict')

riskassessments.conservepriorityscore.desc: A SMALLINT rating (e.g., 1–10) indicating the urgency or priority for conservation actions based on identified risks

sensitivitydata.sensitivityregistry.desc: BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, unique ID for each record of sensitivity details

sensitivitydata.envsensitivity.desc: CHAR(20) for overall environmental sensitivity (possible values: 'Low', 'High', 'Medium')

sensitivitydata.humiditysensitivity.desc: TEXT detailing humidity requirements or maximum humidity tolerance (possible values: 'Medium', 'High', 'Low')

sensitivitydata.pollutantsensitivity.desc: VARCHAR(100) indicating susceptibility to pollutants (possible values: 'High', 'Medium', 'Low')

sensitivitydata.pestsensitivity.desc: TEXT describing vulnerability to pests (possible values: 'High', 'Low', 'Medium')

sensitivitydata.transportsensitivity.desc: VARCHAR(50) specifying special packaging needs (possible values: 'High', 'Low', 'Medium')

sensitivitydata.displaysensitivity.desc: VARCHAR(120) noting special display requirements (possible values: 'Low', 'High', 'Medium')

showcases.showcasereg.desc: CHAR(12) PRIMARY KEY for identifying each showcase (e.g., 'SHOW00000012')

showcases.hallref.desc: CHAR(8) FOREIGN KEY referencing ExhibitionHalls(HallRegistry). Connects the showcase to a particular hall

showcases.airtightness.desc: REAL measuring the physical seal quality, often tested as a numeric rating or leakage rate

showcases.showcasematerial.desc: VARCHAR(80) describing the material (possible values: 'Tempered Glass', 'Glass', 'Acrylic')

showcases.sealcondition.desc: VARCHAR(30) indicating the seal’s condition (possible values: 'Poor', 'Excellent', 'Good', 'Fair')

showcases.maintstatus.desc: CHAR(15) for the showcase’s maintenance status (possible values: 'Overdue', 'Due', 'Good')

showcases.filterstatus.desc: TEXT detailing installed filters (possible values: 'Replace Now', 'Replace Soon', 'Clean')

showcases.silicagelstatus.desc: CHAR(20) noting the condition of silica gel (possible values: 'Active', 'Replace Soon', 'Replace Now')

showcases.silicagelchangedate.desc: DATE of the last silica gel replacement or recharge

showcases.humiditybuffercap.desc: SMALLINT rating or index of the showcase’s capacity to buffer humidity

showcases.pollutantabsorbcap.desc: NUMERIC(5,2) for the pollutant absorption capacity (quantity or threshold)

showcases.leakrate.desc: REAL specifying the rate of air leakage, often tested to ensure stable internal conditions

showcases.pressurepa.desc: BIGINT capturing the internal pressure (in pascals) if pressurization is used

showcases.firesuppresssys.desc: VARCHAR(50) summarizing fire suppression condition (possible values: 'Maintenance', 'Active', 'Standby')

showcases.empowerstatus.desc: CHAR(10) indicating emergency power readiness (possible values: 'Testing', 'Active', 'Standby')

showcases.backupsysstatus.desc: TEXT describing any backup systems (possible values: 'Ready', 'Maintenance', 'Testing') and their condition

surfaceandphysicalreadings.surfphysregis.desc: BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, unique ID for each surface/physical reading record

surfaceandphysicalreadings.envreadref.desc: BIGINT FOREIGN KEY referencing EnvironmentalReadingsCore(EnvReadRegistry). Ties surface data to a general environment reading

surfaceandphysicalreadings.vibralvlmms2.desc: REAL measuring vibration level in mm/s² (millimeters per second squared)

surfaceandphysicalreadings.noisedb.desc: SMALLINT capturing noise level in decibels (dB)

surfaceandphysicalreadings.dustaccummgm2.desc: NUMERIC(5,2) for dust accumulation in milligrams per square meter (mg/m²)

surfaceandphysicalreadings.microbialcoun.desc: INT counting colony-forming units (CFU) of microbes on surfaces

surfaceandphysicalreadings.moldriskidx.desc: NUMERIC(4,2) representing a calculated mold risk index (e.g., 0–10)

surfaceandphysicalreadings.surfaceph.desc: NUMERIC(3,1) measuring pH on the artifact’s surface

surfaceandphysicalreadings.matmoistconte.desc: NUMERIC(4,2) for the material’s moisture content in percentage (0–100%)

surfaceandphysicalreadings.saltcrystalri.desc: CHAR(20) describing risk of salt crystallization (possible values: 'High', 'Low', 'Medium')

surfaceandphysicalreadings.metalcorroder.desc: NUMERIC(4,2) capturing corrosion rate for metal surfaces, e.g., mg/cm² per day

surfaceandphysicalreadings.organicdegrad.desc: NUMERIC(4,2) measuring potential organic degradation (e.g., 0–10 scale)

surfaceandphysicalreadings.colorchangede.desc: REAL indicating color change (Delta E) measurement

surfaceandphysicalreadings.surfacetempc.desc: NUMERIC(5,2) temperature of the surface in Celsius

surfaceandphysicalreadings.surfacerh.desc: NUMERIC(4,1) relative humidity at the surface (percentage)

surfaceandphysicalreadings.condenserisk.desc: VARCHAR(60) describing condensation risk level (possible values: 'Medium', 'High', 'Low')

surfaceandphysicalreadings.thermalimgsta.desc: CHAR(15) summarizing thermal imaging results (possible values: 'Normal', 'Critical', 'Attention Required')

surfaceandphysicalreadings.structstabili.desc: VARCHAR(50) describing structural stability (possible values: 'Stable', 'Minor Issues', 'Major Issues')

surfaceandphysicalreadings.crackmonitor.desc: TEXT field noting crack monitoring details (possible values: 'Significant Changes', 'Minor Changes', 'No Changes')

surfaceandphysicalreadings.deformmm.desc: NUMERIC(5,2) measuring any deformation in millimeters

surfaceandphysicalreadings.wtchangepct.desc: NUMERIC(6,5) capturing weight change in percentage (e.g., 0.00001–99.99999)

surfaceandphysicalreadings.surfdustcover.desc: SMALLINT representing the percentage of surface area covered by dust (0–100%)

surfaceandphysicalreadings.o2concentrati.desc: NUMERIC(4,2) measuring oxygen concentration (e.g., 21.00% for normal air)

surfaceandphysicalreadings.n2concentrati.desc: NUMERIC(4,2) measuring nitrogen concentration (often ~78.00% in air)
